name: voice-claude-kenta4es
description: Voice I/O for Claude Desktop on Windows: Claude reads its replies aloud (SAPI neural voices), you dictate through OpenWhispr (Deepgram Nova-3 or Groq Whisper, with a Russian punctuation pass), and any selected text can be read aloud from any window. Hotkeys for speak-selection / pause / stop / one-key recovery included.
